# DonorDock vs Network for Good Comparison

## **DonorDock**

### Best For
- Small to mid-sized nonprofits
- Organizations wanting simple, affordable donor management
- Churches and faith-based organizations

### Key Features
- **Donor management & CRM**
- Donation tracking and receipting
- Email communication tools
- Basic reporting
- Task management
- Mobile app access

### Pricing
- **Free plan** available (up to 500 contacts)
- Paid plans start around $50-100/month
- Generally more affordable for smaller organizations

### Pros
- User-friendly interface
- Affordable/free option
- Good customer support
- Clean, simple design
- Quick setup

### Cons
- Fewer advanced features
- Limited integrations
- Basic reporting capabilities
- Smaller company with fewer resources

---

## **Network for Good**

### Best For
- Small to medium nonprofits
- Organizations needing fundraising + donor management
- Nonprofits wanting done-for-you support

### Key Features
- **Full fundraising platform** (donation pages, peer-to-peer, events)
- Donor management CRM
- Email marketing
- Extensive reporting/analytics
- Coaching and support services
- Payment processing included

### Pricing
- Typically starts around $100-200/month
- Transaction fees apply (around 3-5%)
- Higher-tier plans with more features available

### Pros
- All-in-one fundraising solution
- Strong coaching/support
- Robust donation pages
- Better for active fundraising campaigns
- More comprehensive features

### Cons
- More expensive
- Can be complex for very small orgs
- Transaction fees add up
- May have more features than needed

---

## **Quick Decision Guide**

**Choose DonorDock if:**
- Budget is tight
- You mainly need donor tracking
- You want simplicity

**Choose Network for Good if:**
- You need active fundraising tools
- You want coaching/support
- You have budget for comprehensive solution
